subject: FinPulse onboarding — split walkthroughs for Console & API
messages:
From: Lynn Cho <lynn.cho@finpulse.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: onboarding@finpulse.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinPulse onboarding — Redwood Console + API walkthrough

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to get our platform team into a hands-on walkthrough for both the Console (observability, routes, and rollouts) and the API/SDK (token usage, batching, auth). Our team is split across SF and London, so I wanted to propose splitting the sessions into two shorter blocks so folks in both regions get something at a reasonable hour.

Proposed: 
- Day 1: Console walkthrough (90 mins) — 2026-07-16 10:00–11:30 PT / 18:00–19:30 BST
- Day 2: API enablement (60 mins) — 2026-07-17 09:00–10:00 PT / 17:00–18:00 BST

Can you confirm availability for Redwood leads and whether a split like this makes sense? We’ll attach our internal list of attendees and a few compliance questions ahead of time.

Thanks,
Lynn
Head of Integrations
FinPulse
[onboarding@finpulse.com]

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: Lynn Cho <lynn.cho@finpulse.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinPulse onboarding — Redwood Console + API walkthrough

Hi Lynn —

Thanks for the clear plan. Splitting into two sessions is exactly what we usually recommend for split-region teams. Both dates work tentatively for our team; I’ll confirm official invites once Priyom and Evelyn verify.

Quick notes / proposal so we’re aligned on scope:
- Console (90 min): brief platform intro (10m), console tour (40m), routing/rollouts + SLOs (20m), Q&A + next steps (20m).
- API (60 min): auth & keys (10m), SDK quickstart + example calls (25m), batching/caching best practices (15m), runbook + Q&A (10m).

We can leave the compliance questions for Evelyn to answer in the Console session or share a short doc ahead of Day 1 — whichever you prefer.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-agenda.csv]

From: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, Lynn Cho <lynn.cho@finpulse.com>
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinPulse onboarding — Redwood Console + API walkthrough

Hi all —

I can take the API enablement session on Day 2 and will prepare a short repo with examples (Python + Node). A couple logistical asks:

1) Can you confirm the typical sequence length and expected request rate for the API calls during the demo so I can set the sample payloads?
2) If you want us to run a small live demo hitting your sandbox, please share an IP allowlist window or I can provide a temporary demo sandbox key.

I’ll prepare the code snippets and a lightweight checklist the engineers can follow post-session.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: api-examples.tar.gz (stub)]

From: Lynn Cho <lynn.cho@finpulse.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: onboarding@finpulse.com
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 07:58:00 +0100
Subject: Re: FinPulse onboarding — Redwood Console + API walkthrough

Hi Vanessa / Priyom —

Thanks — quick update from my side: several engineers in London asked if we could push the Console session 90 minutes later UK time (so it would start at 19:30 BST instead of 18:00) because of an internal all-hands. That would make the session 11:30 PT start, which conflicts with a contractor call for a couple of our SF folks.

Alternative suggestion:
- Keep Day 1 (Console) at 11:30 PT / 19:30 BST but split the Console session into two 45-minute blocks across consecutive days (Day 1a: Console tour / Day 1b: Routing & rollouts + Q&A). That would let many folks catch at least one block.

If Redwood is flexible on splitting Day 1 like this, we’d be happy to keep Day 2 (API) as proposed.

Also attaching our attendee list and a short SOC2 question set.

Thanks,
Lynn
[Attachment: finpulse-attendees.csv]
[Attachment: SOC2-questions.pdf]

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: Lynn Cho <lynn.cho@finpulse.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinPulse onboarding — Redwood Console + API walkthrough

Perfect — we can absolutely split the Console into two 45-minute blocks over two consecutive days. Proposed updated schedule below; I’ll send calendar invites once you confirm attendees:

- Day 1a: Console — Tour & Navigation — 2026-07-16 11:30–12:15 PT / 19:30–20:15 BST
- Day 1b: Console — Routing, Rollouts & Q&A — 2026-07-17 11:30–12:15 PT / 19:30–20:15 BST
- Day 2: API Enablement — 2026-07-18 09:00–10:00 PT / 17:00–18:00 BST

Action items:
- Lynn: confirm final attendee list for each block and whether you want Evelyn to address SOC2 questions in Day 1b or via a shared doc beforehand.
- Priyom: I’ll assign the API repo + example payloads task to you — please add a short README for the sandbox steps.
- Evelyn: please prepare the SOC2 response draft and any evidence references we should share.

Attachments I’ll include in the invite: TrainingDeck-v2.pdf, SOW-FinPulse-draft.docx, and the agenda CSV Lynn referenced.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finpulse-onboarding-20260715
[Attachment: TrainingDeck-v2.pdf (stub)]
